policy.promotion_rule: Promote a candidate to active after it improves a rendered sample and passes visual review.
policy.retirement_rule: Mark superseded rules retired; do not delete their evidence or history.

learnings.title: Lock the environment by scene and camera setup
learnings.directive: Reuse one approved environment plate. Preserve prop inventory, prop positions, set geometry, lighting, and camera pose. Create a new plate only for a scene change, deliberate camera setup change, or explicit environment-changing story event.
learnings.implementation: Render the character separately with transparency and composite it onto the approved plate before interpolation.
learnings.validation: A multi-frame review must show the same background props and layout throughout the shot.

learnings.title: Animate characters independently from the set
learnings.directive: Generate matched character poses as transparent layers with stable identity, wardrobe, scale, lighting direction, and screen position.
learnings.implementation: Composite transparent poses over the locked plate before RIFE or other frame interpolation; avoid chroma keying when alpha is available.
learnings.evidence: Clean Maya walking sprites and environment-locked v2 sample
learnings.validation: Character edges must have no chroma fringe, and distant environment pixels must not be regenerated.

learnings.title: Build walking from three matched key poses
learnings.directive: Use contact A, passing, and contact B, then reverse the interpolated step for a loop.
learnings.evidence: SCENE_01_MS_04 Attempts 001 and 002 showed consistent identity but repeated the same leading foot.
learnings.validation: Rejected: reversing one step produces rocking rather than alternating support.
learnings.retired_reason: Biomechanically incomplete because the opposite-leg half-step is absent.

learnings.title: Build walking from a complete alternating gait
learnings.directive: Use contact, down, passing, and up for the near-leg half-step, followed by contact, down, passing, and up for the far-leg half-step. Interpolate the final pose back to the first; never reverse one half-step to fake the other.
learnings.implementation: Use eight source poses per second and deterministic key-pose holds at 24 fps until adjacent poses are rig-consistent. Preserve the locked environment and loop only to the voice duration.
learnings.evidence: SCENE_01_MS_04 Attempt 004 showed RIFE anatomy deformation; Attempt 005 preserved clean anatomy with deterministic key-pose timing; Attempt 006 showed optical-flow double faces, transparent limbs, and motion trails.
learnings.validation: Approve only after alternating planted feet, opposite arm swing, vertical weight transfer, limited foot sliding, clean anatomy in every delivery frame, stable identity, and a clean loop boundary all pass.

learnings.title: Anchor walking characters to the floor and move them through the set
learnings.directive: Normalize each transparent pose by its visible alpha bounds, anchor the lowest foot to one shared floor coordinate, keep the environment plate fixed, and translate the character layer horizontally at a speed matched to the gait.
learnings.implementation: Build an alpha-preserving pose cycle, overlay it on the locked plate at the configured ground line, and advance its x position continuously for the full voice duration.
learnings.evidence: SCENE_01_MS_04 Attempt 005 exposed varying pose bottoms and camera-only movement that made Maya appear to float in place. Attempt 007 aligned alpha bounds to a shared floor line and moved Maya continuously across the locked set.
learnings.validation: Every support phase must contact the same floor line; the character must advance across the set without background regeneration, per-cycle position resets, or visible hovering.

learnings.title: Finish voice before scene assembly
learnings.directive: Use phrase-aware pacing, restrained pitch and rate changes, light equalization and compression, and 48 kHz delivery audio.
learnings.implementation: Generate voice segments through the repository voice-preview pipeline and attach the matching micro-scene segment during final assembly.
learnings.validation: Check phrasing, pauses, intelligibility, peak control, and synchronization with the scene duration.

learnings.title: Review motion across the entire shot
learnings.directive: Inspect a contact sheet sampled across the rendered clip before approving a reusable motion or continuity pattern.
learnings.implementation: Compare the beginning, transitions, and ending for identity drift, prop drift, edge artifacts, gait discontinuities, and unintended camera changes.
learnings.validation: Record the reviewed output and only promote patterns that pass.
